name: Necro Fleur
extDescription: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Sorciere de Fleur" from your Deck.

name: Sorciere de Fleur
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned, select 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard. Special Summon that monster to your side of the field. It cannot attack your opponent directly, and is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn. The effect of "Sorciere de Fleur" can only be activated once per turn.

name: Z-ONE
extDescription: When this Set card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, select 1 Continuous Spell or Field Spell Card in your Graveyard, and add it to your hand.
